epibox.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Epitech MyEpitech API.

epibox.browserPath.markdownDescription: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium or Firefox executable used for the Microsoft sign-in window. Leave empty to detect it automatically. Without a compatible browser, Bananabox falls back to a copy-and-paste sign-in.

epibox.cloneProtocol.markdownDescription: Protocol used when cloning a project repository. Epitech repositories are normally accessed through SSH.

epibox.defaultCloneDirectory.markdownDescription: Default parent folder proposed when cloning a project. Leave empty to start from your home directory.

enumDescriptions: Ask each time in a dialog.
Open the cloned folder in the current window.
Open the cloned folder in a new window.
Add the cloned folder to the current workspace.
Do nothing.
epibox.afterClone.markdownDescription: What to do once a project repository has been cloned.

epibox.confirmGraderRun.markdownDescription: Ask for confirmation before running the grader, since each run uses one grader token. A warning is always shown when local commits are not pushed or files are uncommitted, whatever this setting says.

epibox.preflightCodingStyle.markdownDescription: Before a grader run, check the whole project with Bananabox Coding Style. Fatal or major issues cancel the run unless you choose to ignore them (a coding style failure scores 0 and still uses a grader token). Only applies when the project folder is available locally.

epibox.autoLocateCodingStyle.markdownDescription: When a finished grader run reports coding style failures, automatically run Bananabox Coding Style on the project to show where they come from.

epibox.deadlineNotifications.markdownDescription: Remind me one day and three hours before the project of the open folder closes, and show a countdown in the status bar.

epibox.autoOpenProjectInEditor.markdownDescription: Automatically open the detailed project page in the editor area when the opened folder is a project repository.

epibox.graderPollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often (in seconds) a running grader job is polled.

epibox.showStatusBarItem.markdownDescription: Show the grader summary (remaining tokens and latest score) in the status bar when a project repository is open.

epibox.language.markdownDescription: Language of the Bananabox interface. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.

bananalens.compiler.markdownDescription: `epiclang` executable. Looked up in `PATH` and the usual install directories; use a full path if it cannot be found.

bananalens.autoIncludes.markdownDescription: Automatically add `-I` for every directory of the project that contains headers (`include/`, `lib/my/`…). This is what makes per-project configuration unnecessary.

bananalens.useMakefile.markdownDescription: Read `-I`, `-D` and `-std` from the project Makefile (static parsing, `make` is **not** run).

bananalens.useCompileCommands.markdownDescription: Use the flags of `compile_commands.json` when the project has one.

bananalens.makeDryRun.markdownDescription: Discover flags with `make -nB` (slow, executes `$(shell)` calls). Rarely needed now.

bananalens.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra flags added to every epiclang run, e.g. `-DDEBUG`.

bananalens.includePaths.markdownDescription: Extra include directories (relative to the project root).

bananalens.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs of files Bananabox Coding Style must not check.

bananalens.configFile.markdownDescription: Optional per-project configuration file (relative to the project root). Almost never needed.

bananalens.runOnSave.markdownDescription: Check a file when it is saved.

bananalens.runOnOpen.markdownDescription: Check a file when it is opened or when its tab becomes active (skipped when the result is already up to date).

bananalens.runOnType.markdownDescription: Check while typing (on a temporary copy of the buffer, debounced).

bananalens.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Wait this many milliseconds after the last keystroke before scanning. 600 ms balances quick feedback with low CPU usage.

bananalens.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Kill epiclang when a run takes longer than this.

bananalens.maxConcurrency.markdownDescription: Maximum parallel epiclang processes. 0 selects 1 to 4 based on available CPUs, to keep editing responsive.

bananalens.problems.enabled.markdownDescription: Publish violations as VS Code diagnostics: underlined in the editor, listed in the Problems panel, with hover and quick fixes.

bananalens.inline.mode.markdownDescription: Styled inline diagnostics with a severity-coloured square, bold text and a subtle message background. `off` keeps only native diagnostic underlines and hover. Customize content, layout and severity colours with [Bananabox Coding Style: Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).
enumDescriptions: Native diagnostic underline and hover only
Level only (rule id in hover)
Level, rule id and message

bananalens.inline.showClangWarnings.markdownDescription: Also show regular clang warnings in the inline text.

bananalens.inline.preferErrorLens.markdownDescription: Defer to Error Lens for diagnostics it has not excluded. Bananabox Coding Style contributes `Banana` and `epiclang` to the default `errorLens.excludeBySource` so its own styled lenses render without duplicates.

bananalens.summary.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the file summary and actions below the header, with counts, recheck and correction mode.

bananalens.summary.position.markdownDescription: Where the recap CodeLens is displayed.

bananalens.summary.attribution.markdownDescription: Show the small “by techneon” lens next to the recap.

bananalens.statusLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the coloured summary badge on an existing blank line below the header. Without a blank line, the recap stays in the CodeLens above the code. Requires `bananalens.summary.enabled`.

bananalens.ruleDocUrl.markdownDescription: URL template that makes the rule id clickable, `{rule}` is replaced by the id (e.g. `C-L2`).

bananalens.projectScanGlob.markdownDescription: Files checked by “Check the whole project”.

bananalens.verbose.markdownDescription: Log the full epiclang command line in the output channel.

bananalens.corrections.mode.markdownDescription: Automatic correction engine: **Off** (default), **Suggestion** (after each save, every fix is shown inline as a diff next to the cursor: `Tab` accepts it, `Alt+]` / `Alt+[` move between fixes, `Esc` dismisses, `Ctrl+Alt+Enter` accepts all), or **Automatic** (apply corrections on save). You can also run **Bananabox Coding Style: Choose correction mode**. Proposals are checked with epiclang before being offered or applied. If verification fails, introduces a diagnostic or exceeds the time budget, corrections are skipped.
enumDescriptions: Disable corrections (default). Banana diagnostics remain enabled.
After saving, review each fix inline: Tab accepts, Alt+] next, Esc dismisses.
Apply layout corrections when saving the file.

bananalens.corrections.clangFormat.markdownDescription: Auto uses a compatible local clang-format or downloads a verified copy into extension storage once. Optionally override with a full executable path.

bananalens.corrections.whitespaceSensiti.markdownDescription: Additional imported macros whose argument whitespace must be preserved (e.g. lowercase macros using stringification). Uppercase calls and function-like macros defined in this file are protected automatically.

bananalens.inline.underline.markdownDescription: Underline the source line using the severity colour.

bananalens.inline.background.markdownDescription: Show a background behind the inline message.

enumDescriptions: Follow Compact / Full mode
Show in both Compact and Full mode
Hide from inline text; keep in hover
Follow Compact / Full mode
Show in both Compact and Full mode
Hide from inline text; keep in hover

bananalens.inline.gap.markdownDescription: Space between source code and inline text, in character widths.

bananalens.inline.maxPerLine.markdownDescription: Maximum messages per line, most severe first. 0 shows all. Remaining messages are counted and available on hover.

enumDescriptions: Keep every message on one line.
Show a box with one message per row on the line holding the cursor; other lines show the most severe message and a +N counter.
Always show the box when a line has several messages. It may cover the code of the following lines.
bananalens.inline.box.markdownDescription: How to display several messages on the same line.

bananalens.inline.colors.fatal.foregroun.markdownDescription: Fatal foreground colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.fatal.backgroun.markdownDescription: Fatal background colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.fatal.underline.markdownDescription: Fatal underline colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.major.foregroun.markdownDescription: Major foreground colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.major.backgroun.markdownDescription: Major background colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.major.underline.markdownDescription: Major underline colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.minor.foregroun.markdownDescription: Minor foreground colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.minor.backgroun.markdownDescription: Minor background colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.minor.underline.markdownDescription: Minor underline colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.info.foreground.markdownDescription: Info foreground colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.info.background.markdownDescription: Info background colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.info.underline.markdownDescription: Info underline colour. Empty uses the theme. Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.functions.enabled.markdownDescription: Flag calls to functions missing from the subject's **allowed functions** (read automatically from the subject PDF, plus the ones you add on the project page). Works without epiclang. Calls to the project's own functions and macros are never flagged.

bananalens.makefile.enabled.markdownDescription: Check Makefiles against the Epitech coding style without epiclang: `##` file header, 80 columns, required rules, binary name from the subject and `.PHONY`.

bananalens.makefile.requiredRules.markdownDescription: Rules every project's main Makefile must define. The rules the subject asks for (e.g. `tests_run`, `unit_tests`) are added automatically.

bananalens.makefile.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: Maximum Makefile line length (C-F3). A tab counts as one column.

bananalens.makefile.wildcard.markdownDescription: Flag `$(wildcard …)` in Makefiles as `[Info] M-W1: Unrecommended wildcard usage`: list sources one by one instead.

bananalens.makefile.missingSources.markdownDescription: Flag the project's `.c` files that the Makefile's `SRC` does not list (`[Info] M-S1`, shown after the last `SRC` entry). Folders with their own Makefile (e.g. `lib/my`) are left to that Makefile.

bananalens.valgrind.command.markdownDescription: Program and arguments valgrind runs, from the project folder (e.g. `./my_ls -l src`). Empty runs `./NAME` from the Makefile. Leaks show as `[Major] VALGRIND` on the line that allocated them; build with `-g` to get the lines.

enumDescriptions: Pick the unit from the amount
Bytes
Kilobytes (1000 B)
Megabytes
Gigabytes
bananalens.valgrind.unit.markdownDescription: Unit of the memory lost by each leak.

bananalens.makefile.missingSourcesIgnore.markdownDescription: Files never reported as missing from `SRC`, as globs relative to the Makefile's folder (e.g. `tests/*.c`, `**/scratch_*.c`).

bananalens.inline.colors.function.foregr.markdownDescription: Unauthorized function foreground colour. Empty uses the theme (slate grey). Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.function.backgr.markdownDescription: Unauthorized function background colour. Empty uses the theme (slate grey). Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).

bananalens.inline.colors.function.underl.markdownDescription: Unauthorized function underline colour. Empty uses the theme (slate grey). Accepts `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA` (alpha). Use the colour picker in [Customize lenses and colours](command:epibox.codingStyle.configureAppearance).
